purpose: Audit FIELD mechanisms by state, causality, legibility, reversibility, identity, provenance, RETURN, and compression; repair only mechanisms that can recover those properties without creating more surface than they remove.

A.name: STATE
A.pass: Canonical or host-owned state is representable independently of rendering/projection.
A.fail: The only state is visual/DOM geometry, animation, or inferred display residue.

B.name: RELATION
B.pass: A relative transform has explicit host/domain meaning and changes a named relation or lawful operation.
B.fail: Geometry or proximity is decorative, generic-carrier semantics leak into the host, or relation cannot be stated without pointing at the picture.

C.name: LEGIBILITY
C.pass: A first-use reader can identify the held object, available operation, and visible consequence without inspector/devtools/project lore.
C.fail: Meaning requires hidden state, jargon lookup, hover-only explanation, or developer inspection.

D.name: REVERSAL
D.pass: Cheap/local transforms are reversible; irreversible changes are gated and FOLD preserves declared residue for BLOOM/RETURN.
D.fail: A local gesture silently destroys state, cannot be undone/reopened, or reversal semantics are ambiguous.

E.name: IDENTITY
E.pass: ROUTE/SCALE/FOLD/BLOOM preserve the addressed referent unless traversal explicitly changes it.
E.fail: Projection changes silently substitute another object, route, source, or authority.
evidence: explicit traversal witness when identity changes

F.name: PROVENANCE
F.pass: User/source/system/LIVE/automation contributions remain distinguishable; borrowed clock does not become borrowed authorship.
F.fail: Actor/source of a mutation cannot be reconstructed or automation is rendered as user-authored state.

G.name: RETURN
G.pass: RETURN records enough before/operation/actor/delta/after/provenance to explain the present state and restore exact context where promised.
G.fail: Only destination snapshots exist, causal path is missing, or RETURN cannot recover the held object/context.

H.name: COMPRESSION
H.pass: The mechanism removes more exposed interaction/learning complexity than it adds while retaining exact recovery.
H.fail: The mechanism adds vocabulary, controls, modes, geometry, or hidden rules without eliminating greater complexity.

decision_rules: FAIL A, B, F, or G -> authority/causality failure: ISOLATE immediately; REPAIR only if one bounded host-local fix restores the invariant, otherwise DELETE/FOLD.
FAIL C, D, or E -> REPAIR once with one bounded mutation; if repair requires a new shell/store/mode or causes H to fail, DELETE/FOLD instead.
FAIL H -> FOLD or DELETE by default. Keep only if a bounded comparator proves net reduction in exposed complexity.
INDETERMINATE -> do not promote; gather the smallest missing evidence only when the mechanism is selected by CURRENT.
A mechanism may be interesting and still be removed. Novelty is not a retention criterion.

integration.reducer_rule: Any audit FAIL that remains unresolved emits RESIDUE; an external proof dependency emits GATE; a completed deletion/repair RETURN may CLOSE to ARCHIVE.
